review: Inspected 16 seeded random examples plus 8 lowest-contrast and 8 smallest-glyph examples. Mixed backgrounds, colours, layouts, stroke styles and warps realized. Annotations remain separate from raw training RGB.
limits: Some stress cases are ambiguous to read/count from pixels. Synthetic instance count is not a claim of perfect human readability. Evaluate uncertainty by visibility/size/contrast and overlap; do not claim guaranteed count recovery.
